opportunities.name: Arbitrum Audit Program ($10M)
opportunities.summary: Apply for subsidized smart-contract audits from Arbitrum's $10M ARB program, launched Aug 1 2025 and running ~12 months through Aug 2026. Eligible projects are early-stage on Arbitrum One or Orbit with new or significantly modified codebases (yet to launch, migrating, or already operational). The Audit Committee reviews on a rolling basis.
opportunities.fit_reason: active bounded audit-subsidy window through Aug 2026; large pool

opportunities.name: ZKsync Community Activation Pilot — RFP Pool
opportunities.amount: 13.6M ZK in the competitive RFP pool (20M ZK total program)
opportunities.summary: Respond to continuously published RFPs in ZKsync's Community Activation Pilot (Aug 27 2025–Aug 27 2026), a 20M ZK program with a 13.6M ZK competitive RFP pool across four tracks: Product Marketing & Activation, Adoption Enablement, Data & Transparency, and Community Tooling. New RFPs are posted on a rolling basis on the ZK Nation governance forum.
opportunities.fit_reason: active 2025–2026 pilot window; rolling RFPs published continuously

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Programs — DeFi Moonshots / Academic Research Awards / RFPs
opportunities.amount: DeFi Moonshots up to $500K in liquidity incentives; Academic Research Awards $25K; plus open RFPs
opportunities.summary: Apply to Sui Foundation's open 2026 funding tracks: DeFi Moonshots (up to $500K in liquidity incentives plus engineering collaboration, no equity), Academic Research Awards ($25K), open Requests for Proposals, and the Hydropower accelerator. All accept applications on a rolling/ongoing basis via sui.io/programs-funding.
opportunities.fit_reason: multiple open 2026 tracks with concrete amounts; standing/rolling

opportunities.name: Stellar Community Fund — Build Award
opportunities.summary: Apply to the Stellar Community Fund Build Award for up to $150,000 in XLM to take a validated project from concept to launch on Stellar. SCF runs continuous ~6-week Build Award rounds; submit the interest form at communityfund.stellar.org to be slotted into the active round.
opportunities.fit_reason: recurring 6-week rounds; verified $150K Build Award on canonical Stellar page

opportunities.name: Circle Developer Grants
opportunities.amount: tiered USDC grants (amounts customized per project, not disclosed)
